public_rationale: OpenAI released Sora to ChatGPT Plus and Pro users on December 9, 2024, meeting the public-launch condition; the days or weeks immediately following that launch have passed [e1]. CODA submitted a copyright-related request on October 27, 2025, following Sora 2's September 30, 2025 release [e2]. That later request does not establish major litigation or comparably consequential formal legal action around the original launch [e2]. The launch announcement and CODA notice establish neither the predicted launch-time legal fight nor its absence through a comprehensive retrospective record [e1; e2].
limitations: The evidence does not comprehensively document the legal aftermath of the December 2024 launch [e1; e2].
CODA's notice does not establish legal action of the predicted severity around either release [e2].
Neither item verifies training on both YouTube and Facebook videos [e1; e2].

The suggestion about training data is the speaker's rationale, not an additional event that must occur before the forecast can be tested.
Public launch means general customer access, including paid access, rather than a research preview.

The first public launch is the principal test; later releases are relevant to the ambiguity in 'any'.

criteria.contradiction_condition: A sufficiently comprehensive contemporaneous or retrospective record establishes that public launch passed without the predicted major legal fight.
